MX.name: Chuchupate
MX.citation: Documented Mexican common name (Grokipedia citing multiple ethnobotanical sources; Desert Tortoise Botanicals Sonoran plant profile). Preferred over the ambiguous 'oshá', which in some Mexican Spanish usage refers instead to Levisticum officinale (garden lovage, a different genus)

US.name: Osha
US.citation: United Plant Savers species conservation profile; Wikipedia. Species is conservation-sensitive due to slow growth and overharvesting
